speaker: Unknown
en: Hey, everybody.
zh: 大家好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hope you had a good lunch.
zh: 希望大家午餐吃得不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know it's one of the last talks of the entire conference.
zh: 我知道这是整个大会最后几场演讲之一了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I tried to make it somewhat engaging and amusing.
zh: 我尽量让它有点趣味性和娱乐性。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, audience participation is encouraged.
zh: 所以，你们知道的，欢迎观众参与互动。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll see how it goes.
zh: 我们走着瞧吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, I'm here with Docker.
zh: 我来自 Docker。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm one of our product managers that works on our new sandbox product.
zh: 我是负责我们新沙箱产品的产品经理之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know if you've seen it.
zh: 不知道你们有没有见过它。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a new binary for Docker.
zh: 它是 Docker 的一个新二进制程序。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's called SBX.
zh: 它叫 SBX。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a micro VM.
zh: 它是一个微型虚拟机。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's really cool.
zh: 它真的很酷。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should come check it out.
zh: 你们应该来看看。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I'm going to tell you why you might want to use it in context of agents doing governance and being safe in general for your agentic platforming needs.
zh: 但我要告诉你们的是，在智能体做治理以及保障你的智能体平台需求安全的大背景下，你为什么可能想用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So right now all of you are doing way more AI than you ever thought you would five years ago.
zh: 所以现在，你们所有人做的 AI 的事，比五年前你们能想到的要多得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: At least I am.
zh: 至少我是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we generally think that we're being protected by our coding harnesses because if we try to do something bad, they will sometimes stop us.
zh: 而我们通常认为我们受到了编码工具的保护，因为如果我们想做坏事，它们有时会阻止我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when we see stories, we think, oh my gosh, I would never make this mistake to have my AI drop my prod database.
zh: 当我们看到那些故事时，我们会想，天哪，我绝不会犯这种错，让我的 AI 删掉我的生产数据库。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I've been doing coding for 30 years.
zh: 你知道，我写代码已经 30 年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no way I would possibly do that.
zh: 我不可能做出那种事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what I decided to find out was, well, what happens if I actually try to hack myself?
zh: 所以我决定去弄清楚的是，如果我真的试着黑掉我自己，会发生什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And how far can I get with, you know, our tools and what we've been told is a safe environment?
zh: 用我们的工具、用我们被告知是安全的环境，我能走多远？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I opened up my Claude code on desktop on my Mac, and I had it look for my browser history, and it found it right away, which I was very impressed about.
zh: 于是我在我的 Mac 桌面上打开了我的 Claude code，让它去找我的浏览器历史记录，它立刻就找到了，这让我印象非常深刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I asked it, what can I do with this?
zh: 我问它，这个能用来做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we started looking at my bank accounts, which I was surprised about.
zh: 于是我们开始查看我的银行账户，这让我很吃惊。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it found them, which I was very unhappy about.
zh: 它找到了，这让我非常不爽。

speaker: Unknown
en: I made fake bank names.
zh: 我用了假的银行名称。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is not my real data, just so you know.
zh: 提醒一下，这不是我的真实数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it did find all of my real bank data on there.
zh: 但它确实在上面找到了我所有真实的银行数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it went even further.
zh: 而且它走得更远。

speaker: Unknown
en: It found that I've been ordering checks recently, that I've been using Zelle.
zh: 它发现我最近一直在订购支票，还一直在用 Zelle。

speaker: Unknown
en: It told me the last four digits of the account I was using.
zh: 它告诉了我所用账户的后四位数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was very impressed.
zh: 我印象非常深刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: And here's kind of an idea of all the PII that it found.
zh: 这里大致展示了它找到的所有 PII(个人身份信息)。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is from, again, the Claude desktop app that we thought was safe.
zh: 再说一遍，这是来自我们本以为安全的 Claude 桌面应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anyways, maybe there's a better solution.
zh: 总之，也许有更好的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who knows?
zh: 谁知道呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: So the next day I came in and I got from my security team a nice little notice that they thought I'd been hacked.
zh: 所以第二天我来到公司，收到了安全团队的一个小小的通知，他们以为我被黑了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I had to explain to them that, no, no, no, I'm just putting together a talk for this conference.
zh: 于是我不得不向他们解释，不不不，我只是在为这次大会准备一个演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: And please, please don't flag me as a compromised computer.
zh: 拜托拜托，千万别把我标记为被入侵的电脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then they sent me the CrowdStrike report from this, which I asked them to do.
zh: 然后他们给我发来了由此产生的 CrowdStrike 报告，这是我让他们做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was quite impressed with it.
zh: 我对它印象相当深刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: Apparently this is a known way to get credentials from a machine.
zh: 显然这是一种已知的从机器上获取凭证的方法。

speaker: Unknown
en: Didn't realize that.
zh: 我之前没意识到这点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I had scored very well on this.
zh: 而我在这个报告里得分很高。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got a 9 out of 10, which is better than I did in most of my classes.
zh: 我拿到了 10 分中的 9 分，这比我大多数课程的成绩都好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was really good.
zh: 所以那真的很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: But fortunately, this was just me internally.
zh: 不过幸运的是，这只是我自己内部的行为。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was not some sort of injection from a script or MCP server or anything that could easily happen.
zh: 它不是来自某个脚本或 MCP 服务器或任何类似东西的注入，而那种情况是很容易发生的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So five prompts is what it took.
zh: 所以只需要五个提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had to be a little clever.
zh: 我得稍微动点脑筋。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you just ask straight up, like, hey, Claude, go find my bank data, it will give you a warning.
zh: 如果你直接问，比如，嘿，Claude，去找我的银行数据，它会给你一个警告。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you say, I'm researching how to do security, it'll happily go and help you do that research on your account.
zh: 但如果你说，我在研究如何做安全，它就会很乐意地去帮你在你的账户上做那项研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not your friend.
zh: 它不是你的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if only there was a better way to do this using a sandbox MicroVM technology that Docker and others have released recently.
zh: 所以，要是有一种更好的方法来做这件事就好了，使用 Docker 和其他公司最近发布的沙箱 MicroVM 技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: So rather than just saying please, which if you look in some of these Claude prompts you'll see, please don't do nefarious things, right?
zh: 所以与其只是说“请”，如果你看看这些 Claude 提示词中的某些部分，你会看到，“请不要做邪恶的事情”，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like that is the level of security we're at.
zh: 这就是我们目前所处的安全水平。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now we've got microVMs.
zh: 所以现在我们有了 microVM。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're not aware of them compared to you, I know you're probably all aware of Docker, been using it for years.
zh: 如果你不了解它们，相比——我知道你们可能都知道 Docker，已经用了很多年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The new thing now that we and others are doing is with microVMs.
zh: 现在我们和其他人正在做的新东西就是 microVM。

speaker: Unknown
en: They run their own kernel.
zh: 它们运行自己的内核。

speaker: Unknown
en: They isolate your file system.
zh: 它们隔离你的文件系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a system that will go and make sure that the sandbox never actually sees your secrets.
zh: 我们有一套系统，会去确保沙箱永远不会真正看到你的密钥。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you try to go and do a network request, it takes a placeholder, replaces it so that your sandbox and your agent can't do bad things.
zh: 当你尝试发起网络请求时，它会取一个占位符并替换掉它，这样你的沙箱和你的智能体就不能做坏事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've got a full audit trail for it.
zh: 我们为此有完整的审计追踪。

speaker: Unknown
en: So yeah, you want to be secure by design, not just hope and say please and see what's going to happen.
zh: 所以是的，你要做到设计即安全，而不只是抱着希望说“请”，然后看看会发生什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're trying to do this balancing act.
zh: 我们在尝试做这种平衡。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we can't actually do these things, the agent's not useful.
zh: 如果我们实际上不能做这些事情，智能体就没用了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's why this whole sandbox idea is so exciting for us.
zh: 所以这就是为什么整个沙箱的想法对我们来说如此令人兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: We encourage you to use it.
zh: 我们鼓励你们使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And maybe don't let your bank data get into the hands of your agent.
zh: 也许不要让你的银行数据落入你的智能体手中。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not what you want.
zh: 那不是你想要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is what it looks like in practice when you're running a sandbox.
zh: 这就是你在实际运行沙箱时看到的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the left side is when I run Claude.
zh: 左边是我直接运行 Claude 的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And on the right side is when I do SBX run Claude.
zh: 右边是我运行 SBX run Claude 的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can see that there's a lot of differences.
zh: 你可以看到有很多差异。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a joke.
zh: 那是个玩笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sorry, they're not.
zh: 抱歉，并没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just the bypass permissions are on.
zh: 只是 bypass permissions 开着而已。

speaker: Unknown
en: But nothing else was hard to do, right?
zh: 但没有其他什么难做的事，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Running that command on the right automatically creates a new VM.
zh: 在右边运行那个命令会自动创建一个新的 VM。 [[62→]] 它在那个文件夹里把它启动起来，并为你创建一个新沙箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: It spins it up in that folder, and it makes a new sandbox for you.
zh: 它在那个文件夹里把它启动起来，并为你创建一个新的沙箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: It runs your agent.
zh: 它运行你的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now you're up and running.
zh: 现在你已经启动并运行了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can't see anything.
zh: 它什么都看不到。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if we try to do our browser history attack on regular Claude, it happily goes and finds your browser history.
zh: 所以，如果我们尝试在普通 Claude 上做我们的浏览器历史攻击，它会很乐意地去找到你的浏览器历史。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if I run it on the sandbox version, it does not even think there's a browser installed on your machine.
zh: 但如果我在沙箱版本上运行它，它甚至不会想到你的机器上装了浏览器。

speaker: Unknown
en: So pretty cool.
zh: 所以挺酷的。

speaker: Unknown
en: No difference.
zh: 没有区别。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had to type seven more keystrokes to get here.
zh: 我只是多按了七个按键才到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think it's well worth the price to pay.
zh: 但我认为这个代价是完全值得的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Same thing is true for network egress and ingress.
zh: 网络出站和入站也是同样的道理。

speaker: Unknown
en: So right here, I tried to get it to go and look up the pirate bay, because I knew that would be blocked.
zh: 就在这里，我试着让它去查找海盗湾，因为我知道那会被拦截。

speaker: Unknown
en: And sure enough, blocked by default.
zh: 果不其然，默认就被拦截了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other thing you kind of see, it's hard, maybe it's hard to see, but like the
zh: 你还会注意到的另一件事，可能很难看清，但是那个——

speaker: Unknown
en: Claude likes to really send back a lot of telemetry data to their data dog instance.
zh: Claude 非常喜欢向他们的 data dog 实例发回大量遥测数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you're using Claude, you are sending Anthropic a lot of your data, unless you're using sandboxes, in which case you're cleverly being blocked by that.
zh: 所以如果你在使用 Claude，你就是在向 Anthropic 发送大量你的数据，除非你在使用沙箱，那样你就会被巧妙地拦截掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other thing I'll say about sandboxes, they're so easy to use.
zh: 关于沙箱我还要说的另一点是，它们非常容易使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every developer at Docker now writes all of their code in sandboxes.
zh: 现在 Docker 的每个开发者都在沙箱里写他们所有的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are using this every day.
zh: 所以我们每天都在用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're writing all of our code in it.
zh: 我们所有的代码都是在里面写的。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we don't use it, we get yelled at.
zh: 如果我们不用它，就会被骂。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's worth our time to go and do that.
zh: 所以花时间去这么做是值得的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Little defaults on this.
zh: 这方面有一些小的默认设置。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of this is configurable.
zh: 所有这些都是可配置的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so now that we've talked about why this matters, right?
zh: 那么既然我们已经谈过为什么这很重要了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So doing this at the hardest level doesn't really work.
zh: 在最外层做这件事其实不管用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents find their way around it.
zh: 智能体会找到绕过它的办法。

speaker: Unknown
en: If it gets down to your host machine, it's too late.
zh: 一旦到了你的宿主机上，就太晚了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you want to be at that micro VM boundary.
zh: 所以你要在 micro VM 边界上做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We think it's the best way.
zh: 我们认为这是最好的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Other people do, too.
zh: 其他人也这么认为。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's easy to use.
zh: 而且它易于使用。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're working in consulting, if you've got a chief security officer, if you do client work, whatever it might be, you're probably dealing with this on a day to day basis.
zh: 如果你在做咨询，如果你有一位首席安全官，如果你做客户项目，不管是什么情况，你可能每天都在处理这类问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So not only do you want this to be useful, but also you want to do things and enable your agents to do different things, right?
zh: 所以你不仅希望这个东西有用，还希望用它做事，并让你的智能体去做各种不同的事情，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of the things we're really excited about is doing agent-level identity tracking and delegation chains.
zh: 所以我们非常期待的事情之一就是做智能体级别的身份追踪和委托链。

speaker: Unknown
en: So when you can start saying, hey, how come this thing happened?
zh: 这样当你开始问，嘿，这件事是怎么发生的？

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can go back and say, oh, that's because an agent did it and a human actually authorized that agent to do it.
zh: 你可以回溯并说，哦，那是因为一个智能体做的，而实际上是一个人授权那个智能体去做这件事的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It didn't just happen by magic.
zh: 它不是凭空魔法般发生的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like we don't know what happened.
zh: 而不是像我们现在这样，不知道发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we're going to start tracing that, tell you about it, and let you write policy that actually goes and does degradation of what you can do based on cedar policies, based on new things happening.
zh: 现在我们要开始追踪这些，告诉你相关情况，并让你编写策略，基于 cedar 策略、基于新发生的事情，实际去执行对你所能做之事的降级。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you might say to yourself, oh my gosh, this is so good.
zh: 你可能会对自己说，哦天哪，这太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like to buy it now.
zh: 我现在就想买。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do I buy this from you guys?
zh: 我该怎么从你们这里买这个？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I have my marketing slide that my marketing team is really mad at me that I made this, but I think it's funny and cute for AI governance.
zh: 这里有我的营销幻灯片，我的营销团队对我做了这个非常生气，但我觉得对 AI 治理来说它挺有趣挺可爱的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So definitely talk about that.
zh: 所以一定要来聊聊这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: OK, what does AI governance look like?
zh: 好，AI 治理是什么样的？

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what it looks like in kind of a mock-up.
zh: 这大概就是一个原型的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: So right now, we do network.
zh: 目前，我们做的是网络。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can set allow, deny.
zh: 你可以设置允许、拒绝。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can do file system points.
zh: 你可以做文件系统挂载点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can also decide what your MCP catalog looks like.
zh: 你还可以决定你的 MCP 目录是什么样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, if you're running our MCP server, our MCP servers themselves run on a sandbox.
zh: 另外，如果你在运行我们的 MCP 服务器，我们的 MCP 服务器本身就是运行在一个沙箱里的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they are also governed by all of these different controls.
zh: 所以它们同样受所有这些不同控制的约束。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the future, we're going to be adding more stuff.
zh: 将来，我们会增加更多东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the things we've heard from a lot of people at this conference is that they want to do L7 networking controls.
zh: 在这次大会上我们从很多人那里听到的需求之一，就是他们想做 L7 网络控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: They want to do per GitHub repo file system level controls.
zh: 他们想做按 GitHub 仓库的文件系统级控制。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want your agent to be able to read and write to some repos and some areas of some repos, but not others.
zh: 你希望你的智能体能够读写某些仓库和某些仓库的某些区域，但不能读写其他的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So all of this is going to be coming down the line, but everything that I've showed you today is working, and you should come by our booth and see that.
zh: 所以所有这些都会陆续推出，但我今天展示的所有东西都是可以运行的，你应该到我们的展位来看看。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's easy to install.
zh: 它安装很简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: We run on Mac, Windows, and Linux based on your package manager of choice.
zh: 我们可以运行在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上，基于你选择的包管理器。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can see at the end, it's just SBX run Claude.
zh: 你可以在最后看到，就是 SBX run Claude。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not just Claude, by the way.
zh: 顺便说一句，它不只是 Claude。

speaker: Unknown
en: The sandboxes are a full VM.
zh: 这些沙箱是完整的 VM。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can run a shell.
zh: 所以你可以运行一个 shell。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can run codex.
zh: 你可以运行 codex。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can run whatever.
zh: 你可以运行任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can run a Python job.
zh: 你可以运行一个 Python 作业。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can run...
zh: 你可以运行……

speaker: Unknown
en: A web server, anything you want to do.
zh: 一个 web 服务器,任何你想做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we want to make it easy for you to get in and up and running.
zh: 但我们想让你能轻松上手并快速跑起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is kind of our default.
zh: 所以这算是我们的默认设置。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can just get in.
zh: 这样你就可以直接进入。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can get that Claude Code or Codex instance going.
zh: 你可以让那个 Claude Code 或 Codex 实例跑起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: It feels native.
zh: 它感觉很原生。

speaker: Unknown
en: It works just the same way as your one did today.
zh: 它的工作方式和你今天用的那个完全一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you've got all these projections in store.
zh: 但你还有所有这些投影等着去看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Additionally, you can mount other file systems.
zh: 此外,你还可以挂载其他文件系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what I do is when I'm working on a piece of code with related repositories, I'll mount those read-only.
zh: 所以我做的事是,当我在处理一段代码并涉及相关代码仓库时,我会把它们以只读方式挂载。

speaker: Unknown
en: That way, my agent can see what I'm doing.
zh: 这样,我的智能体就能看到我在做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can see my other code base.
zh: 它能看到我其他的代码库。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I know it's not going to make random commits to other repos just to make my thing work.
zh: 但我知道它不会为了让自己的东西跑通就对其他代码仓库做随意的提交。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want the guarantee that it's actually doing what it says it's doing with the API that I've specified.
zh: 我想要一个保证:它确实是在用它所说的、用我指定的 API 在做它说的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's it.
zh: 就这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pretty short.
zh: 相当简短。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a booth.
zh: 我们有一个展位。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a few sunglasses left and some power banks to give away.
zh: 我们还剩几副太阳镜和一些充电宝要送出去。

speaker: Unknown
en: You should come by our booth and I'll walk over there afterwards and give you the demo and then you can look as good as Macho Man Randy Savage with those glasses.
zh: 你应该来我们展位,之后我会走过去给你做演示,然后你戴上那些眼镜就能看起来和 Macho Man Randy Savage 一样酷。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there you go.
zh: 就是这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

en: Thank you.
